tools.name: google_hotels_photos
tools.description: Fetch the full set of photos for a single Google Hotels property via SerpAPI. Requires a `property_token` taken from a google_hotels_search result. Paginate with next_page_token.

tools.name: google_hotels_reviews
tools.description: Fetch reviews for a single Google Hotels property via SerpAPI. Requires a `property_token` taken from a google_hotels_search result. Filter by category_token or source_number, order with sort_by, and paginate with next_page_token.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "google_hotels_search" is 1298 chars, far longer than this server's median (230). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
